# src/__tests__

Test suite validates core functionality: auth middleware, cache layer, config loading with env interpolation, response store, utils, binary builds, and provider integrations using bun:test framework.

## Contents

### Unit Tests

- [auth.test.ts](./auth.test.ts) Tests `createAuthMiddleware` from `../middleware/auth.js` with mock FastifyRequest/FastifyReply, validates 401 errors for missing/invalid keys, 200 success with correct `req.clientLabel`
- [cache.test.ts](./cache.test.ts) Tests `MemoryCache`, `generateCacheKey`, `createCache`, `CacheManager` from `../cache/index.js`, validates cache key format `/^[a-f0-9]{15,16}$/` and streaming request bypass
- [config.expanded.test.ts](./config.expanded.test.ts) Tests `loadConfig`, `getEnabledProviders` from `../utils/config.js`, validates `${VAR}` and `${VAR:-default}` interpolation, required field validation, provider enablement logic
- [config.test.ts](./config.test.ts) Tests `loadConfig` from `../utils/config.js` error handling for missing config files
- [response-store.test.ts](./response-store.test.ts) Tests `ResponseStore` from `../response-store.js`, validates CRUD ops, size tracking, clear/delete behavior
- [utils.test.ts](./utils.test.ts) Tests `truncateKeyForLogging`, `sanitizeProviderRequest`, `SSE_DONE_SENTINEL` from `../utils/cache-utils.js`, validates key truncation to 32 chars, request sanitization

### Integration Tests

- [binary.integration.test.ts](./binary.integration.test.ts) Spawns built binary on port 19002, validates `/health` and `/health/providers` endpoints, measures build/startup time
- [fireworks.integration.test.ts](./fireworks.integration.test.ts) Spawns server on port 19001, validates `/v1/chat/completions` with model alias `claude-sonnet`, confirms `provider: "fireworks"` in response

## Test Framework

Uses `bun:test` with `describe`, `test`, `expect`, `beforeAll`, `afterAll`, `beforeEach`, `afterEach`. Logger mocked to "error" level to suppress output. Temp directories created via `mkdtempSync`, cleaned via `rmSync`.

## Test Patterns

- Mock requests: `createMockRequest(authHeader)` returns `Partial<FastifyRequest>` with headers
- Mock replies: `createMockReply()` returns mock with chained `status(code).send(payload)`, tracks statusCode/payload
- Server lifecycle: spawn subprocess, poll `/health` endpoint (100ms interval after 500ms delay, 30s timeout), kill via `SIGTERM`
- Cache fixtures: `ChatCompletionRequest` and `ChatCompletionResponse` mocks, cleanup via `clear()` and `disconnect()`

## Behavioral Contracts

- Cache key hash: `/^[a-f0-9]{15,16}$/` (xxHash64 hex)
- SSE sentinel: `SSE_DONE_SENTINEL` equals `"data: [DONE]"`
- Binary startup port: 19002
- Fireworks integration port: 19001
- Truncated log key: exactly 32 characters + "..."
- Auth error response shape: `{ error: { message, type: "authentication_error", code: "missing_api_key" | "invalid_api_key" } }`
- Env var interpolation: `${VAR}` from process.env, `${VAR:-default}` fallback to default, undefined vars without default become empty string

## Coverage

`src/__tests__/` validates all major modules: `../middleware/auth.js`, `../cache/index.js`, `../utils/config.js`, `../response-store.js`, `../utils/cache-utils.js`. Integration tests confirm binary build artifact and Fireworks provider live API connectivity.
